purpose: Implement a Node HTTP Hosted Route Runner for the frozen QA-0 route/base/fixture contract without Playwright or Browser/UI interaction.

probeCurrent.purpose: Prove live HTTP transport and route/asset checks against the currently deployed gh-pages source without claiming candidate freshness.

freshness.strictRequirement: deployed source SHA must equal caller-provided expected source SHA

checks.DEPLOYED_COMMIT_FRESHNESS: Resolve source SHA from gh-pages commit message and compare in strict mode; probe-current never upgrades this to a strict candidate-freshness claim.
checks.REPOSITORY_BASE_PATH: Every same-origin emitted asset/shell reference must stay under /langrisser-future-guide/ except no explicit exception.
checks.PUBLIC_ROUTE_RESOLUTION: GET all QA-0 required public routes in canonical trailing-slash form and require HTTP 200 HTML.
checks.DETAIL_DIRECT_ENTRY: GET all representative Hero/Soldier/Equipment detail fixtures directly and require HTTP 200 HTML.
checks.REFRESH_EQUIVALENT_GET: Repeat direct-entry GET with a new cache-busting query and require a second successful HTML response.
checks.TRAILING_SLASH_POLICY: GET non-slash public/detail directory URLs and require the final followed URL pathname to resolve to trailing slash.
checks.ASSET_AND_CHUNK_RESOLUTION: Extract shell scripts, stylesheets, preload/modulepreload/icon references plus a bounded representative image sample; exact emitted URLs must return 2xx.
checks.FILENAME_CASE_SENSITIVITY: Treat exact emitted asset URL 404 as failure; no case-insensitive fallback or filename similarity repair.
checks.ROUTE_TREE_HOSTED_PARITY: Require every frozen public route and representative detail pattern to have a live hosted success fixture.
checks.STALE_DEPLOY_OR_CACHE: Use no-store headers and unique query values and combine them with the gh-pages source-SHA check.
